> *"You cannot get through a single day without having an impact on the world around you. What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make."* — Jane Goodall

### About me

I am a biostatistician with a keen interest in unravelling complex population processes—particularly within the field of health—through mathematical and statistical modelling.

**Statistical Interests:**

- Bayesian statistics, survival analysis and event-history methods, longitudinal and multilevel models, stochastic processes, and causal inference.

**Research and Application Areas:**

- **Quantitative Demography:** Mortality patterns and trends, migration dynamics, population projections, and statistical methods for demographic analysis.
- **Population Epidemiology and Health Inequalities:** Health inequalities, substance use epidemiology, environmental epidemiology, and infectious disease modelling.

Outside research, I enjoy running 🏃‍♂️, swimming 🏊‍♂️, photography 📷, and philosophy 📚.
